# Metric dictionary

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:metrics` from packages/analytics/src/registry.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Dictionary version **1.2**. The CLI and the MCP adapter read the same registry (`@fmmi/analytics`, `METRIC_REGISTRY`). Every result names the definitions it used on its envelope (`metrics`: version, unit, derivation, confidence), and each metric row states only what differs from that envelope. A change to a formula or threshold must bump the version of the affected definition. Source facts and their limits: `docs/data-coverage.md` (it takes precedence over spec section 2.4).

## Version history

The dictionary version changes whenever a definition is added, removed or re-versioned. Cached season aggregates are keyed by it and by the version of each definition they use, so a bump rebuilds them (a stale aggregate is never served).

## Conventions

- **Windows** are half-open `[from,to)` on the canonical boundary `(period, tick, sequence)`. Adjacent windows count a boundary event once. A full-match query ends at an explicit end-of-recording boundary after the last frame.
- **Time**: 240 ticks = 1 game minute. Playing minutes are the sum of on-pitch tick deltas inside one period, halftime excluded; never wall time, a nominal 90 minutes or display-minute subtraction.
- **Cumulative counters** are sampled (ticks have gaps). A window delta is `counter(before to) - counter(before from)`. A sampled boundary makes the row `partial_for_window`; a missing baseline is `null` with `missing_baseline`; a decreasing counter is `null` with `unverified_semantics`. Nothing is interpolated and snapshots are never summed.
- **Events** are placed by event start tick and period. They reconcile to counters exactly over a whole recording; inside a window the counter can trail an event by up to 4 ticks, so reconciliation tolerates the pass events that straddle a sampled boundary (reported as `within_boundary_tolerance`).
- **Rounding** is presentation only: counts are integers, xG has 2 decimals, percentages and rates have 1 decimal. Stored and compared values keep source precision; reconciliation uses unrounded values.
- **Null reasons**: `not_recorded`, `unsupported_version`, `partial`, `unverified_semantics`, `missing_baseline`, `unresolved_boundary`, `zero_denominator`, `not_applicable`. Missing is `null` with a reason, never zero.
- **Names** in archives are untrusted data. Renderers escape them; Markdown output backslash-escapes every Markdown-significant character.
- **Partial recordings**: match-level output states the capture status, the captured interval and the end boundary. Totals are over the captured interval and are never presented as full-match totals. A manual final score is labelled manual and observed counters are never altered by it.

## Pass scopes

| Scope | Definition | Set pieces | Counter reconciliation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `counter_scope` (default) | All pass events (types 6-11) except those flagged `0x8` (throw-ins). Crosses (12-17) are a separate counter. | Free-kick and corner-taken passes are included; throw-ins excluded. | Exact: equals the cumulative `passes` and `passesCompleted` counters (0 residual on the audited recording, at team and player level). |
| `all_passes` | All pass events (types 6-11), throw-ins included, crosses separate. | Throw-ins included. | No equivalent counter, so reconciliation is unavailable and the recipient gate fails. Allowed and labelled. |
| `open_play` | Pass events excluding flags `0x8`, `0x10`, `0x20`, `0x40`. | Free-kick flags excluded. | None. Flags `0x10`/`0x20` are unverified, so it carries an `unverified_semantics` warning, is never compared with counter totals and fails the recipient gate. |

## Recipient gate (spec 7.2)

Computed per recording, side and window; never hard-coded to a pass. It passes only when all hold: receiver semantics verified for completed passes (basis `internal_corroboration`: Receiver position equals trajectory end (median 0.004 m); receiver in roster and on the passer team for every completed pass on the audited recording. Not checked against the FM27 UI), at least 95% of the eligible completed pass events have a verified receiver (in the roster, on the passer team, not the passer), and the event totals reconcile to the equivalent counters within the source tolerance (integer counters: 0). Missing evidence or an unknown reconciliation fails it. 95% is a configurable product quality gate, not statistical confidence. On failure the observed links stay inspectable with warnings and the passing, aerial and shooting fallback is returned; no claim about little or no service is made. Receiver-specific attempt and success rates are always `null` with `not_recorded`: incomplete passes carry no receiver.

## Finding rules

### `low_aerial_success_v1` (version 1)

Low aerial success

- Gate: at least 5 verified aerial attempts in the window and aerials_won / aerials <= 25%.
- Thresholds: minAttempts = 5; maxWinRatio = 0.25.
- Language: Counts only. Labelled a descriptive heuristic; it does not establish that distribution or player selection caused the outcome.

### `reception_rate_comparison_v1` (version 1)

Reception rate comparison

- Gate: in EACH window: >= 15 verified playing minutes and >= 30 verified team completed passes during those minutes; equivalent pass scope; adequate coverage; a named comparator; the section 7.2 recipient gate passes.
- Thresholds: minPlayerMinutes = 15; minTeamCompletedPasses = 30; recipientCoverageMin = 0.95.
- Language: Reports the direction and size of the difference. No absolute low-service label.

### `progression_rate_comparison_v1` (version 1)

Progressive-pass rate comparison

- Gate: in EACH window: >= 15 verified playing minutes and >= 30 verified team completed passes during those minutes; both counters resolved; a named comparator.
- Thresholds: minPlayerMinutes = 15; minTeamCompletedPasses = 30.
- Language: Compares the upstream progressive-pass counter per 90. No absolute weak-progression label.

Other rules: a window with a single shot suppresses firm chance-quality findings (`single_shot_window`); no absolute low-service or weak-progression label exists; no recommendation is produced; no causal language is used. The comparative gate measures exposure (verified playing minutes and team completed passes during those minutes) and never the subject own count, so a player with no receptions is still comparable. These are initial product gates, not significance tests or calibrated tactical norms.

## Comparison context and confounders (spec 7.1)

Every comparison carries a `context` block: verified minutes leading, drawing and trailing for each side (from that side's team perspective, from the observed goal counters; a frame score holds until the next frame; null with a reason if goals cannot be resolved), the substitution flips of either team inside the window, and a `confounders` list. These are labelled heuristics, not calibrated norms: `different_score_state` when the dominant score states differ or any state share differs by more than 0.25 (equality does not fire); `different_minutes_on_pitch` when the shorter side has less than 0.5 of the longer side's minutes; `substitutions_in_window`; `score_state_unavailable`. Findings are not suppressed by confounders; the context is stated beside them and the comparison does not adjust for it.

## Pooled aggregation

Season percentages and per-90 rates pool numerators and denominators (`pooledRatio`): `100 * sum(numerators) / sum(denominators)`. Individual match ratios are never averaged. A match with a missing numerator or denominator contributes to neither, and the contributing and excluded counts are reported. A pooled zero denominator is `null` with `zero_denominator`.

## Season eligibility and trends (Slice 4)

One function (`seasonEligibility`) decides which recordings count; the season, player and tactical-change queries all call it.

- **Rates**: Nonconflicting completed or completed_manual matches with full_match capture; plus confirmed matches whose capture ends early with a trustworthy baseline, no gap or missing period, and at least the early-ending minimum of captured game minutes (disclosed as early_ending).
- **Totals and win/draw/loss**: Only full_match captures. Observed totals never include unseen time, so an early-ending match is left out of totals with a reason. Win/draw/loss use the manual final score (labelled manual) or a verified final score.
- **Excluded, with a reason per match**: unknown or in_progress completion, unresolved identity conflicts, partial captures that are not early-ending or fall below the minimum, and undated matches (no in-game date, so no rolling order).
- **Partial opt-in**: includePartial shows recordings excluded only for partial capture in a separate block with its own pooled rates; they are never mixed into the main comparison.
- **Ordering**: In-game match date ascending, ties by import time then match id. A replayed fixture is a separate occurrence.
- **Rolling windows**: the last 5 and the last 10 eligible matches, each with home and away splits.
- **Early-ending minimum**: 80 captured game minutes (heuristic, not a calibrated norm). Equality qualifies. A match with a gap over the tolerance, a missing period or an unverified baseline is a partial capture, not an early ending.
- **Pooling**: every ratio and per-90 rate is `scale * sum(numerators) / sum(denominators)` over the contributing matches; per-90 denominators are measured captured minutes (teams) or verified on-pitch minutes (players). Each row lists its numerator, denominator, contributing matches and minutes, and each excluded match with the reason (`not_recorded`, `missing_baseline`, `did_not_play`, `recipient_gate_failed`).
- **Receiver-based metrics** (`passes_received_per_90`, `passes_received_pct_of_team_completed`) use only recordings whose side passes the per-recording section 7.2 recipient gate; a recording that fails it is excluded from that metric with `recipient_gate_failed`. Reception counts are all completed receptions in the counter scope: they are not ground service, which is unavailable (`ground_service_receptions`).
- **Player identity**: trends accept a save-scoped persistent player id (`pe_...`). A match-local id (`p_...`) is excluded and listed until it is linked. A persistent identity is created automatically only when the same positive upstream uid appears in two or more matches of the save and the display name agrees; a uid with different names is flagged `identity_conflict` and not merged; names alone never merge.
- **Player comparison context**: a cross-match player comparison carries the same kind of context as a single-match one. Each player window lists its contributing matches (matches with verified minutes above zero), the opposition faced, and the player own minutes leading, drawing and trailing (the same `scoreStateMinutes` over the player on-pitch segments, summed as exact ticks over the contributing matches; unavailable with a reason if any contributing match lacks it). Each comparison carries a `confounders` list under the comparison thresholds above: `different_score_state`, `different_minutes_on_pitch`, `score_state_unavailable` and the fixed `opposition_strength_unavailable`. Confounders never suppress a finding and nothing is adjusted for them.
- **Tactical change comparison**: before and after rates per 90 minutes of verified team time, within the match that contains the note and across the preceding and following eligible matches (the match that contains the change is left out of the across sets). Context (score state, home/away mix, opposition names, players on pitch, coverage) is reported beside the rates; thresholds are labelled heuristics: windows under 15 verified minutes warn, different score state uses the comparison thresholds above and home/away mix differs when the home share differs by more than 0.25. A single-match comparison says so. The comparison is observational and never states a cause.

### `attack_lane` (version 1)

Attack lane (left, centre, right thirds of pitch width)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | derived |
| Unit | normalised_pitch |
| Confidence | deterministic |
| Derivation ID | width_thirds_attack_perspective_v1 |
| Source fields | `event.source`, `event.flags&0x100`, `pitch half width (metadata, metres)` |
| Formula | lateralUnit = (attack-rotated lateral metres + halfWidth) / (2 * halfWidth); left if lateralUnit < 0.3333, right if lateralUnit >= 0.6667, otherwise centre; not clamped |
| Scope | Any event with a source point, or a pass trajectory end where stated. |
| Eligibility | Pitch dimensions known and the event point present. |
| Null reasons | not_recorded |
| Sample gate | none (raw values are reportable at any sample size) |
| Rounding | integer |
| Source tolerance | float32 coordinates |
| Thresholds | leftBelow = 0.3333333333333333; rightFrom = 0.6666666666666666 |
| Source semantics | Mirroring rule: An event is placed in the lane of the team that ATTACKS. For the attacking team own events use the event lateralUnit as recorded (attack-rotated). For a defending team event (tackle, interception, aerial duel) the opposition attack direction is the reverse, so the point is mirrored with lateralUnit -> 1 - lateralUnit; the opposition left lane is the defending team right flank and the reverse. Lanes are identical in both halves and for both teams by construction. Handedness is verified by player position labels (left-sided positions average low lateralUnit), not assumed. |

| Scope | Team or player over the whole recording; pooled across eligible matches (season policy). |
| Eligibility | Count resolved and minutes > 0 in the contributing match; a match with a missing count contributes to neither numerator nor denominator. |
| Null reasons | zero_denominator, missing_baseline |
| Sample gate | Raw counts and minutes are always reported; comparative findings keep the exposure gates. |
| Rounding | 2 decimals (presentation only) |
| Source tolerance | exact |
| Thresholds | none |
| Source semantics | Recorded opposition aggregate xG; per-shot values are not substituted. |

### `chance_creation_by_wing_trend` (version 2)

Chance creation by wing across matches (pooled)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | derived |
| Unit | count |
| Confidence | deterministic |
| Derivation ID | pooled_lane_counts_per_90_v1 |
| Source fields | `opposition_shots_by_lane`, `opposition_xg_by_lane`, `opposition_crosses_by_lane`, `opposition_final_third_entries_by_lane`, `danger_area_entries_by_lane`, `attack_lane` |
| Formula | Per match and side, the per-match lane counts of the threat query (run once with each side as the attacker): shots, per-shot xG, crosses, completed crosses, final-third entries, danger-area entries. Over the matches of a window each count is summed per lane; per90 = 90 * summed count / summed measured captured minutes of the contributing matches. Never an average of match rates. |
| Scope | The selected team (for: lanes where it attacked; against: lanes where the opposition attacked, from the opposition perspective, so the opposition left lane runs down the selected team right flank), pooled over the eligible matches of each window (season policy). |
| Eligibility | Pitch dimensions recorded for the match. A match without them is listed as excluded (pitch_dimensions_not_recorded) and contributes to no lane. Events without a location are counted apart (withoutLocation), never assigned to a lane. Per-shot xG that cannot be attributed is counted in xgUnattributedShots and is in no lane. |
| Null reasons | not_recorded |
| Sample gate | Raw pooled counts are always reportable. No lane is ranked and no threat score is produced; per-90 rates over very few minutes are shown with their minutes. |
| Rounding | counts are integers; summed xG is rounded to 4 decimals and per-90 rates to 3 decimals in the result (keeps the response bounded); sums and ratios are formed before rounding |
| Source tolerance | 0 for counts (they equal the sum of the per-match lane counts); xG is a sum of float32 values |
| Thresholds | leftBelow = 0.3333333333333333; rightFrom = 0.6666666666666666 |
| Source semantics | Descriptive pooled counts per lane and direction. Early-ending recordings contribute their measured minutes to the denominator, so the counts are over the captured interval only and no unseen time is included. A difference between lanes is not a cause. |

These are reported as unavailable with the reason; no value is substituted.

| Component | Reason | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `final_third_touches` | unverified_semantics | No section 7.7 registry definition yet; touch event fidelity is not audited. |
| `support_proximity` | unverified_semantics | No section 7.7 registry definition yet; needs tracking samples and validated orientation. |
| `opponent_centre_back_matchup` | not_applicable | Context only; not computed. |
| `receiver_specific_attempt_rate` | not_recorded | Incomplete passes carry no receiver (0 of 145 on the audited recording). |

| `ground_service_receptions` | not_recorded | No ground/air classification exists in the event schema. |
